name: Princess Brave! ~Jantaku no Kishi~
original_name: プリンセスブレイブ! ～雀卓の騎士～
source:
One Year after the events of Princess Bride,  graduation day closes on. Still none of the girls are chosen to be a princess and they are desparete. 

One night suddenly black mists engulf the house amids a loud laughter and everyone finds themseves in a magical world. Strange people appear clad in black and our hero gets turned into a dog. Whats is going on? What do you mean the only way to set things back to normal is to win this mahjong game?
A strange and magical adventure begins...

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=83401]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
《Princess Bride》的故事结束一年后，毕业之日渐渐临近，却仍没有任何女孩获选为公主，众人心急如焚。

一天夜里，黑雾在高亢的笑声中突然吞没宅邸，所有人发现自己置身于魔法世界。身穿黑衣的怪人现身，主人公也被变成了一条狗。这究竟是怎么回事？什么叫只有赢下这场麻将才能让一切恢复原状？
一场奇异的魔法冒险就此开始……

[翻译自[url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=83401]Getchu[/url]]
